name: argument-parser-positive-test-e41e5b8a0a/optional-none-first-v
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature

## Invocations / ### Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
reason: The asserted output requires launching main with no command-line arguments and supplying nil for its required nullable string parameter. Subset 10 supports parameter signatures and ordinary function invocation but does not cover this command-line entry-point argument binding protocol. Signature support alone does not establish omitted CLI arguments becoming nil.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line invocation of main(string? s) with an absent argument bound to nil
test_design_notes: No @args is present; @output expects 'string value: s is nil', so the absent CLI argument behavior is essential. The conditional, string concatenation and io:println instrumentation do not independently establish a feature gap.
